_comment: What each POI category is and which interfaces it implements. One contract for the builder, the renderer, the weather engine and the party layer.

interfaces.Locatable: has a coordinate the map can draw and the router can snap to
interfaces.Rideable: a height rule may apply; the filter and the report button care
interfaces.Queueable: may carry e — a queue entrance is a claim on the ride, not a row
interfaces.Reportable: ride status can be set and replicated
interfaces.Sheltered: weather treats as under cover by default
interfaces.Schedulable: opening hours would matter if they were ever read
interfaces.MeetCandidate: a named standing-room place suitable as a reunification point
